component.name: Aura
component.summary: Mac-inspired modern App Store tailored exclusively for Hyprland on Arch Linux

description.p: Aura is an ultra-fast, minimal GTK4/libadwaita App Store designed specifically for Hyprland on Arch Linux and CachyOS, featuring an authentic macOS App Store aesthetic.

ul.li: Tailored specifically for Hyprland Wayland compositor with live diagnostics, 1-click window rules, and Electron Wayland Ozone optimization
Seamless native Debian (.deb) package installer with 175+ Debian-to-Arch dependency mappings, FHS normalization, and Pacman tracking
Instant fuzzy search across official Pacman repositories and AUR via Paru/Yay or native makepkg fallback
Isolated OCI container sandbox using native Docker with Wayland and PipeWire audio pass-through
System Doctor with stale db.lck unlocking, orphaned package cleanup, and Arch PGP keyring repair
Liquid 60FPS fluid spring animations and macOS micro-interactions
